seo.title: Flipping: buy low and sell high across cities
seo.pageDescription: Cross-city arbitrage ranking: buy an item cheap in one city and sell it expensive in another, no crafting involved. Tap a row to see where every number comes from.
seo.intro: Flipping is buying an item cheap in one city (against a sell order) and selling it expensive in another (by posting your own sell order or against a buy order), with no crafting in between. This ranking covers {count} items with a market price and a known real name, ordered by the silver they yield per day, not by unit margin.
seo.metaDescription: Albion Online flipping ranking: {count} items ranked by realizable silver per day buying cheap in one city and selling expensive in another.
seo.faq1Q: What is flipping in Albion Online?
seo.faq1A: Buying an item cheap in one city (against a sell order) and selling it expensive in another (by posting your own sell order or against a buy order), with no crafting in between.
seo.faq2Q: How is a flip's silver per day calculated?
seo.faq2A: Margin per unit (net-of-tax sell price minus buy price) times the smaller of the buy and sell cities' daily volume, times the market share you assume.
seo.faq3Q: Why aren't every item in the game listed?
seo.faq3A: Only items with a market price and a known real name are included. Some unnamed materials (certain refining catalysts and raw ingredients) are deliberately left out instead of being shown under a made-up name.
